$comment: Pinned upstream versions for the telemetry binaries. Every platform package bundles one archive from each source below, extracted + repacked into the platform package's bin/ directory.
Updates to versions are deliberate, one-pin-per-change. Do not bump from CI automation — changes here trigger a republish of all four platform packages.

otelcol note: we use otelcol CORE distribution (not contrib, not k8s). Core is ~168 MB (vs contrib ~339 MB) and still includes every component our locked logs-only pipeline needs — OTLP receivers, batch + memory_limiter processors, file exporter (with rotation), and health_check extension. Verified against otelcol v0.150.1 component list. k8s distribution is Linux-only so not an option for darwin platforms.
